Account::qbo_id#2
ExternalLink::InternalId#2
ExternalLink::ExternalId#10
ExternalLink::ExternalLinkTypeId#9
Item::id#1
Item::qbo_id#2
Payment::id#1
Payment::qbo_id#11
PaymentLine::id#1
PaymentLine::qbo_id#6
PaymentMethod::id#3
PaymentMethod::qbo_id#1
Term::id#1
Term::qbo_id#2
SalesTransaction::id#1

name: Convert QBO SalesLine Into Karbon SalesLine
purpose: Converts one QBO sales line (Description, LineNum, Id, Amount, ItemRef, TaxCodeRef, UnitPrice, Qty) into a Karbon SalesLine JSON: looks up the Karbon Item id (271), maps tax code 'TAX' to taxable=1 else empty, finds the existing SalesLine id by parent SalesTransaction and qbo_id, and returns the JSON.
open_question: $ParentId (parsed from json 'ParentId', step 42) must be injected by the caller; the sample payload has no such key. Item lookup passes QBOId as JSONNumber. $id (step 36 $Id) is reused case-insensitively at step 66.

name: Convert Karbon SalesLine into QBO SalesLine
purpose: Converts one Karbon SalesLine (by id) into a QBO sales line: reads description, qbo_lineNum, qbo_id, amount, item, taxable, unit price and quantity, maps the Item to its QBO id (327), maps taxable to QBO tax code 'TAX' / 'NON' (USA tax model), and builds the line JSON with DetailType SalesItemLineDetail.
reads:
SalesLine::description#5
SalesLine::qbo_lineNum#4
SalesLine::qbo_id#2
SalesLine::amount#6
SalesLine::ItemId#9
SalesLine::taxable#11
SalesLine::unitPrice#7
SalesLine::qty#8
open_question: Step 43 sets Id to 0 when the line has no qbo_id; step 44 hard-codes 'If ($id=9; 12; $id)' (a QBO id remap with no comment). No transaction wrapper, unlike its siblings. Reads SalesLine without a DBTransactions selector, so it relies on the current record context established by the caller.

name: List of SalesTransactions FMIds to Send
purpose: Returns the ids of SalesTransactions whose qbo_id column equals 1 (SQL.GetColumn(id; qbo_id; 1)); intended as the list of FMIds to send to QBO.
callers: none found (may be called by name)
open_question: Comparing qbo_id to 1 looks like a placeholder for a 'needs send' flag; the real definition of 'pending to send' is unresolved (compare Payment::qbo_send used in the payment push). Callers: none found.

name: Lookup SalesTransaction Type ( QBOId )
purpose: Given a QBO id returns the InvoiceInd flag of the matching SalesTransaction (tells whether the sales transaction is an invoice); returns a Bad Request error when the id is empty.
open_question: Returns the raw InvoiceInd (1/0), not a type name as the title suggests. Callers: none found.
